pairs: Igitur congregata omni turba filiorum Israël,
Therefore, when all the multitude of the sons of Israel had gathered together,
Hæc sunt quæ jussit Dominus fieri.
“These are the things that the Lord has ordered to be done:
For six days you shall do work;
and the rest of the Lord,
whoever will have done any work in it shall be killed.
Non succendetis ignem in omnibus habitaculis vestris per diem sabbati.
You shall not kindle a fire in any of your dwelling places throughout the day of the Sabbath.”
Et ait Moyses ad omnem catervam filiorum Israël:
And Moses said to the entire crowd of the sons of Israel:
Iste est sermo quem præcepit Dominus,
“This is the word which the Lord has instructed,
Separate from among you the first-fruits to the Lord.
Omnis voluntarius et prono animo offerat eas Domino:
Let all who are willing and have a ready soul offer these to the Lord:
and the skins of rams, dyed red,
et gemmas ad ornatum superhumeralis et rationalis.
to adorn the ephod and the breastplate.
And whoever among you is wise,
and make what the Lord has commanded:
and the panels with the bars,
the tent pegs and the bases,
and the veil that is drawn before it,
the table with its bars and vessels,
and the bread of the presence,
the lampstand to hold up the lights,
and the oil to the nourish the fire,
the altar of incense and its bars,
et oleum unctionis et thymiama ex aromatibus:
the tent at the door of the tabernacle,
the altar of holocaust and its grate of brass,
et craticulam ejus æneam cum vectibus et vasis suis:
with the columns and the bases,
the hanging at the doors of the vestibule,
the tent pegs of the tabernacle and the atrium,
quorum usus est in ministerio sanctuarii,
which are to be used in the ministry of the Sanctuary,
vestes Aaron pontificis ac filiorum ejus,
the vestments of Aaron, the high priest, as well as those of his sons,
in order to exercise the priesthood to me.”
Egressaque omnis multitudo filiorum Israël de conspectu Moysi,
And all the multitude of the sons of Israel, departing from the sight of Moses,
obtulerunt mente promptissima atque devota primitias Domino,
offered the first-fruits to the Lord with a most ready and devout mind,
to accomplish the work of the tabernacle of the testimony.
Quidquid ad cultum et ad vestes sanctas necessarium erat,
Whatever was needed for worship and for the holy vestments,
omne vas aureum in donaria Domini separatum est.
And every vessel of gold was separated, to be donated to the Lord.
fine linen and the hair of goats,
they offered it to the Lord,
along with setim wood for various uses.
Sed et mulieres doctæ, quæ neverant, dederunt hyacinthum,
But the skillful women also gave whatever they had spun:
and vermillion, as well as fine linen,
donating everything of their own accord.
the leaders offered onyx stones and gems,
for the ephod and the breastplate,
and also to produce incense with a most sweet odor.
Omnes viri et mulieres mente devota obtulerunt donaria,
and women offered donations with a devout mind,
quæ jusserat Dominus per manum Moysi.
so that the works might be done which the Lord had ordered by the hand of Moses.
Cuncti filii Israël voluntaria Domino dedicaverunt.
All the sons of Israel dedicated voluntary offerings to the Lord.
And Moses said to the sons of Israel:
vocavit Dominus ex nomine Beseleel filium Uri,
the Lord has called by name Bezalel, the son of Uri,
the son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah,
and he has filled him with the Spirit of God,
ad excogitandum, et faciendum opus in auro, et argento, et ære,
to design and to fashion, with gold and silver and brass,
and with the skill of a carpenter.
he has given to his heart.
Ooliab quoque filium Achisamech de tribu Dan:
It is likewise with Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach from the tribe of Dan.
He has taught both of them wisdom,
in order to do the work of carpentry,
and to discover whatever may be new.”
